clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon sends an urgent plea for help to Stormwind. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs press around the town, and he has no garrison troops to spare for the journey. He entrusts a traveler with The State of Lakeshire for General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.

Gnolls contest every road from Lakeshire, while Blackrock orcs raid from the north. The town's guardsmen are stretched beyond their limits. Magistrate Solomon cannot spare fighting men for the days-long ride to the capital, so a traveler carries his official plea for regular troops to the city gates.

General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind's defense. Solomon's report reaches him, and he respects the magistrate's leadership and recognizes the urgency. Yet army protocol bars Jonathan from mobilizing troops without a royal directive. Redridge's defense must wait until he consults the young King Anduin and the regency council.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These are trying times, adventurer. The township is under constant siege. Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat. The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance. Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately. Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader. His words carry great weight with me. I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him. Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support. Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
